title: Moscow — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Moscow: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Moscow has a population of 12,600,000. Russia’s sprawling capital, a global metropolis with iconic Kremlin and Red Square, world-class museums, and a vibrant cultural scene. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 96 sunny days a year.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
